deviations: Retained upstream UPSTREAM.txt (rewritten for this chain), MIT licences and the generic and Effect rule sources; the local plugins use Vite+'s bundled vite-plus/lint/plugins API instead of a separately pinned oxlint.

Dropped the donor's domain rules: no-dev-server, no-implicit-date-time-zone, no-multi-statement-unsafe, no-owned-table-write, no-unkeyed-command-row, no-zoneless-calendar-interval, with their tests and the donor's tools/oxlint/package.json.
Renamed the generic plugin from vektor-anti-slop to reebeat-anti-slop; it is not loaded by the root configuration because Ultracite's anti-slop preset enables the identical 18 rules.
Only the five Effect rules (effect/index.ts) are loaded and enabled at error.
